```plato
//==
// # library Polynomials
//
// Closed-form evaluation of the low-degree power-basis polynomials and of the
// cubic spline bases (Bezier, Hermite, Catmull-Rom), plus their first and second
// derivatives.
//
// The coefficients / control values are typed `INumerical`, which inherits
// IAdditive (a + b, a - b, Zero) and IScalable (v * scalar, v / scalar) — exactly
// the operations a polynomial in a scalar variable needs. So a
// single definition serves Number, Vector2D, Vector3D, Point deltas, Color, and
// every quantity type. The variable itself is
// always a plain `Number`; `INumerical` deliberately does NOT give
// IMultiplicative, so `value * value` is unavailable here and every product with
// the parameter is written as a scalar multiply.
//
// These are the base case the curve/surface layer is missing: an `Eval` on
// CubicBezier2D/3D, HermiteCurve2D/3D or CatmullRomCurve2D/3D is a one-line call
// into the corresponding function below.
//
// Not repeated here: `Barycentric` (already generic on INumerical in
// algebra.library.plato) and `SmoothStep`/`SmootherStep` (Number-concrete
// shaping functions, also in algebra.library.plato).
//
// Conventions: coefficients come first in descending-power (school) order,
// matching the QuadraticPolynomial/CubicPolynomial/QuarticPolynomial types of
// `polynomials.types.plato`; the variable is last. Bezier/Hermite/Catmull-Rom
// parameters t are in [0, 1].

library Polynomials
{
    //==
    // # Power-basis polynomials

    // m*x + b. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear_equation
    Linear(m: INumerical, b: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => m * x + b;

    // The derivative of Linear: the constant slope m.
    LinearDerivative(m: INumerical, b: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => m;

    // The second derivative of Linear: zero everywhere.
    LinearSecondDerivative(m: INumerical, b: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => m.Zero;

    // a*x^2 + b*x + c. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadratic_function
    Quadratic(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * x.Square + b * x + c;

    // The derivative of Quadratic: 2*a*x + b.
    QuadraticDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * (2.0 * x) + b;

    // The second derivative of Quadratic: the constant 2*a.
    QuadraticSecondDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * 2.0;

    // a*x^3 + b*x^2 + c*x + d. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_function
    Cubic(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * (x.Square * x) + b * x.Square + c * x + d;

    // The derivative of Cubic: 3*a*x^2 + 2*b*x + c.
    CubicDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * (3.0 * x.Square) + b * (2.0 * x) + c;

    // The second derivative of Cubic: 6*a*x + 2*b.
    CubicSecondDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * (6.0 * x) + b * 2.0;

    // a*x^4 + b*x^3 + c*x^2 + d*x + e. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quartic_function
    Quartic(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, e: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * (x.Square * x.Square) + b * (x.Square * x) + c * x.Square + d * x + e;

    // The derivative of Quartic: 4*a*x^3 + 3*b*x^2 + 2*c*x + d.
    QuarticDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, e: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * (4.0 * x.Square * x) + b * (3.0 * x.Square) + c * (2.0 * x) + d;

    // The second derivative of Quartic: 12*a*x^2 + 6*b*x + 2*c.
    QuarticSecondDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, e: INumerical, x: Number): INumerical
        => a * (12.0 * x.Square) + b * (6.0 * x) + c * 2.0;

    //==
    // # Bezier bases
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve
    // Control values in order; the curve leaves the first and arrives at the last.

    // The quadratic (3-point) Bezier at t: (1-t)^2*a + 2(1-t)t*b + t^2*c.
    QuadraticBezier(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => a * (1.0 - t).Square
         + b * (2.0 * (1.0 - t) * t)
         + c * t.Square;

    // The first derivative (velocity) of the quadratic Bezier:
    // 2(1-t)(b - a) + 2t(c - b).
    QuadraticBezierDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => (b - a) * (2.0 * (1.0 - t))
         + (c - b) * (2.0 * t);

    // The second derivative of the quadratic Bezier: the constant 2(a - 2b + c).
    QuadraticBezierSecondDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => (a + c - b * 2.0) * 2.0;

    // The cubic (4-point) Bezier at t:
    // (1-t)^3*a + 3(1-t)^2*t*b + 3(1-t)t^2*c + t^3*d.
    CubicBezier(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => a * ((1.0 - t).Square * (1.0 - t))
         + b * (3.0 * (1.0 - t).Square * t)
         + c * (3.0 * (1.0 - t) * t.Square)
         + d * (t.Square * t);

    // The first derivative (velocity) of the cubic Bezier:
    // 3(1-t)^2(b - a) + 6(1-t)t(c - b) + 3t^2(d - c).
    CubicBezierDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => (b - a) * (3.0 * (1.0 - t).Square)
         + (c - b) * (6.0 * (1.0 - t) * t)
         + (d - c) * (3.0 * t.Square);

    // The second derivative of the cubic Bezier:
    // 6(1-t)(a - 2b + c) + 6t(b - 2c + d).
    CubicBezierSecondDerivative(a: INumerical, b: INumerical, c: INumerical, d: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => (a + c - b * 2.0) * (6.0 * (1.0 - t))
         + (b + d - c * 2.0) * (6.0 * t);

    //==
    // # Cubic Hermite basis
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline
    // Endpoints p0, p1 with outgoing tangent m0 and incoming tangent m1:
    //   H(t) = (2t^3 - 3t^2 + 1)*p0 + (t^3 - 2t^2 + t)*m0
    //        + (-2t^3 + 3t^2)*p1    + (t^3 - t^2)*m1

    // The cubic Hermite segment at t, passing through p0 at t=0 and p1 at t=1.
    Hermite(p0: INumerical, p1: INumerical, m0: INumerical, m1: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => p0 * (2.0 * t.Square * t - 3.0 * t.Square + 1.0)
         + m0 * (t.Square * t - 2.0 * t.Square + t)
         + p1 * (3.0 * t.Square - 2.0 * t.Square * t)
         + m1 * (t.Square * t - t.Square);

    // The first derivative (velocity) of the cubic Hermite segment:
    // (6t^2 - 6t)*p0 + (3t^2 - 4t + 1)*m0 + (6t - 6t^2)*p1 + (3t^2 - 2t)*m1.
    HermiteDerivative(p0: INumerical, p1: INumerical, m0: INumerical, m1: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => p0 * (6.0 * t.Square - 6.0 * t)
         + m0 * (3.0 * t.Square - 4.0 * t + 1.0)
         + p1 * (6.0 * t - 6.0 * t.Square)
         + m1 * (3.0 * t.Square - 2.0 * t);
```
